Metadata.title: SCENTLOG — A diary of fragrance
Metadata.description: Track the fragrances you own, test and want. Rate them, review them and follow people whose taste you trust.

Home.heroBody: Keep track of what you own, what you have tested and what you are saving for. Rate it, write about it, and see what the people you follow are wearing.

log.title: Log
log.body: Every bottle on your shelf, every blotter you tested, every scent on your wishlist — and the ones you finished to the last drop.

rate.title: Rate
rate.body: Half-star ratings, with optional notes on longevity, projection, sillage, versatility and value.

collect.title: Collect
collect.body: Lists for everything: your signature rotation, the best vetivers, winter evenings. Public or just for you.

follow.title: Follow
follow.body: Follow noses you trust. See their collections, their top four and what they reached for today.
